correctness.rationale: The proof is finite and exhaustive. An exact checker reconstructs the sixteen lower regular triangles from the published integer valuation vector, verifies unimodularity and total normalized area, builds the four reflected Viro charts with exact rational midpoint coordinates and projective boundary identification, reproduces all four sample topology/count rows from the source, and checks every one of the 16384 projective sign orthants. For every orthant it verifies that the component count is A+B+C+1 and that the published lift characters give 4, 8, 16, or 28 real bitangents. No sampling or timeout inference is used.

value.rationale: The source itself links coefficient signs to both bitangent reality and Viro topology but gives only sample sign choices. Exhausting the entire natural sign space for its canonical worked example supplies a complete chamber invariant, not an arbitrary slice: it identifies the topology attached to every bitangent-sign pattern and distinguishes which of the three classical four-bitangent topologies is actually accessible in this tropical chamber. The exact orthant distribution is also useful as a reproducible benchmark for real tropical quartic computations.
